unix_socket.description: Path to the HAProxy stats socket; must be accessible and configured with 'level admin' in HAProxy.

read_only.description: If true, disables CLI and only queries stats.

filters.description: List of stat filters in format '<iid> <type> <sid>'. Each entry corresponds to a -f/--filter option.

proxies.description: List of proxy filters in format '<pxname>'. Each entry corresponds to a -p/--proxy option.
